Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from the game. It was a comprehensive win for the India Women Under-19. The ICC Under 19 Women's T20 World Cup continues as we have four games lined up on Sunday, 15th of January - West Indies Women U19 versus Ireland Women U19 and Pakistan Women U19 versus Rwanda Women U19 at 1.30 pm IST (8.00 am GMT), and England Women U19 versus Zimbabwe Women U19 and New Zealand Women U19 versus Indonesia Women U19 at 5.15 pm IST (11.45 am GMT). Do join us for the early build-up as well. Till then, take care and goodbye. Cheers!

Shafali Verma the skipper of India Women Under-19 says that the pitch is good to bat. Adds that they enjoy scoring and South Africa played well too. Adds that it was a test for them and they need to get better and better with time. Ends by saying that they enjoyed the game and it feels good to win the game.

Oluhle Siyo the skipper of South Africa Women Under-19 says that the girls did well with the bat. Adds that it was a batting pitch but India was better. Says that they need a lot of refocusing and the girls are learning and we see it in the play. Ends by saying a huge thank you to the crowd.

Shweta Sehrawat is the player of the match. She says they thought of accelerating from the start. Shafali was accelerating at the start and she continued after her dismissal. Adds that this is her best in the T20 so far. Ends by saying that they go with the plan and she has no pressure when she is batting alongside Shafali Verma.
... Presentations coming up ...

Earlier in the game, South Africa Women Under-19 got off to a flier as they put on 56 runs for the opening wicket in just four overs. It was Simone Lourens who ran a havoc over the Indian bowlers. They slowed down a bit after losing the first wicket and ended their innings for 166. From the bowling point of view, Parshavi Chopra was the pick of the bowlers with her spell of 4-0-15-1. Shafali Verma was quite economical and bagged two wickets while Sonam Yadav took one.

South Africa Women Under-19 were fine with a ball at the start. They struggled to get wickets at regular intervals and a 26-run over from Nthabiseng Nini was quite expensive as well. Miane Smit, Madison Landsman, and Seshnie Naidu bagged one wicket each for their team. They will be looking to leave this behind and bounce back into the league.

India Women Under-19 started off steadily with both the openers playing safe but Shafali Verma charged up on the sixth over from Nthabiseng Nini and scored 26 runs to get India in the driver's seat. She was dismissed by Miane Smit in her first over after scoring 45 off just 16 deliveries. After her dismissal, Shweta Sehrawat carried on with the good work and kept the scoreboard ticking. She scored 92* off 57 deliveries and won the game for India getting some support from the nonstriker's end as well.

FOUR! Shweta Sehrawat rightfully scores the winning runs! This has been a remarkable performance for the vice-captain of India Women Under-19. Madison Landsman bowls this short and outside the off stump. Shweta Sehrawat gets across and slaps this towards deep cover for four runs.
This is short and outside the off stump. Soniya Mendhiya slaps this towards cover and a misfield allows them to take a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Soumya Tiwari gives her wicket away just before the finish line! Madison Landsman flights this one full and in line with the stumps. Soumya Tiwari shimmies down the wicket and lofts this straight down the throat of long on. Elandri Rensburg makes no mistake and India Women Under-19 lose their third wicket. 2 runs are required.
Commentary.Howout: c Elandri Rensburg b Madison Landsman

Commentary.Commentary: Soniya Mendhiya walks in.
WIDE! Madison Landsman fires this one down leg on a fuller length. Soumya Tiwari misses her sweep and the umpire calls this wide.

This is short and outside the off stump. Shweta Sehrawat punches this towards cover.

Kayla Reyneke floats this one full and into the stumps. Soumya Tiwari clips this towards mid on.
This is bowled on a length and outside the off stump. Soumya Tiwari cross bats this towards mid on for a run. Just 14 runs are needed now.

WIDE! Goes full and wide outside off. Shweta Sehrawat leaves this one alone and the umpire calls this wide. Probably a but harsh.

Continues bowling short and outside off. Shweta Sehrawat looks to thump this away but misses.
WIDE! Bowls this one way outside off on a shorter length. The umpire calls this one wide.

Continues to bowl short and outside off. Shweta Sehrawat chooses to leave this one alone.

FOUR! Shweta Sehrawat is leading her team over the finish line in style! This is short and outside off. Shweta Sehrawat cuts this towards deep point and collects four runs.
FOUR! Great use of the feet! Madison Landsman flights this one is full and in line with the stumps. Shweta Sehrawat charges down the wicket and powers this down to long on for four runs.
Madison Landsman goes full and into the pads. Shweta Sehrawat knocks this straight to mid on.
FOUR! A good over spoiled with a boundary! Ayanda Hlubi goes full and on the pads. Soumya Tiwari clips this towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Bowls this one short and wide outside off. Soumya Tiwari reaches for it and hits it uppishly over cover for a couple of runs.
Goes full this time and into the stumps. Soumya Tiwari clips this towards mid-wicket.
On a good length as well and wide outside off. Soumya Tiwari swings hard but gets beaten Three dot balls now.
Ayanda Hlubi continues to bowl on a good length and outside the off stump. Soumya Tiwari strokes this solidly towards mid off.
Ayanda Hlubi bowls this on a good length and just outside off. Soumya Tiwari blocks this towards cover.
Fires this one full and outside off. Shweta Sehrawat leaves this one alone.
Flights this full and outside off. Shweta Sehrawat sweeps this straight to square leg,
FOUR! This has smashed away! Madison Landsman bowls this short and outside off. Shweta Sehrawat thumps this towards deep cover for four runs.
Full once again and outside off. Soumya Tiwari strokes this towards deep cover for a single.
Goes full and angles this into stumps. Soumya Tiwari clips this towards mid-wicket.
Madison Landsman bowls this short and in line with the stumps. Soumya Tiwari pushes this towards cover.
FOUR! Another loose delivery gets the treatment! A low full toss once again and on the pads. Shweta Sehrawat repeats the shot and gets another four runs.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! FIFTY for Shweta Sehrawat! Seshnie Naidu bowls a low full toss going down leg, Shweta Sehrawat sweeps this towards deep backwqard square leg for four runs.

Soumya Tiwari is the next batter.

OUT! STUMPED! A wicket right after the break! Seshnie Naidu floats this one full and outside the off stump. Gongadi Trisha pushes at the ball and gets beaten on the outside edge. Karabo Meso grabs the ball and waits for the batter to get off balance before whipping the bails off. The leg umpire raises his finger immediately and Gongadi Trisha has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: st Karabo Meso b Seshnie Naidu

Commentary.Commentary: DRINKS! India Women Under-19 got off to an explosive start and are now in a comfortable position in this game. 61 runs are needed in the last 10 overs and should be a walk in the m=park for their strong batting lineup. The South Africa Women Under-19 bowlers have not been able to get any sort of rhythm and need quick wickets if they are to claw their way back into the game.

Fuller and on off, Gongadi Trisha drills it towards long off for one.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Gongadi Trisha moves forward and drives it uppishly over extra covers for a boundary!
Fuller one, around off, Gongadi Trisha taps it to the woman at point.
FOUR! Pitched up, on off, Gongadi Trisha gets on her knee and slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Lands it on off, Gongadi Trisha lofts it over extra covers for a brace.
Fuller and outside off, Shweta Sehrawat uses the pace of the ball and guides it towards third man. The fielder does well to stop it at the fence and the batters collect two.
Bowls it outside off, Shweta Sehrawat looks to play at it but misses.
FOUR! Lands it on middle and leg, Shweta Sehrawat paddles it through fine leg for another boundary. Excellent placement!
FOUR! A low full toss on off, Shweta Sehrawat gets on her knee and slogs it. It carries towards deep mid-wicket and the fielder makes a mess of it as it races away the fence. A chance gone abegging.
Fuller and on middle, Shweta Sehrawat eases it back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Shweta Sehrawat lofts it over the diving fielder at mid off for a boundary!
On off, played towards the fielder at covers.

Fuller and on off, Gongadi Trisha taps it to the women at point.
Lands it outside off, Gongadi Trisha looks to slap it but misses.
Fuller and on off, Gongadi Trisha pushes it to mid off.
Gongadi Trisha is the new batter at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Miane Smit comes into the attack and gets the big fish. Lands it on off, Shafali looks to loft it but mistimes it completely. It goes up in the air towards long off. Elandri Rensburg settles under it and pouches it comfortably. Shafali Verma walks out after an excellent knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Elandri Rensburg b Miane Smit
